# Appeal of Denial — Partial Knee Replacement (CPT 27446)

**Member:** Reese Mercado
**Member ID:** W529317483
**Plan:** Cigna (Commercial/ACA), Arizona
**Denial date:** 2026-08-01
**Reference number:** POC-8AD74FF769-66861
**Governing policy:** Cigna CMM-311 Knee Replacement/Arthroplasty V1.0.2026 (Partial Knee Replacement section) — https://www.evicore.com/sites/default/files/clinical-guidelines/2026-04/Cigna_CMM-311%20Knee%20Replac%20Arthro_V1.0.2026_Eff08.04.2026_Pub04.20.2026.pdf (effective 2026-08-04)

Dear Cigna Appeals Department,

I am appealing the denial of my partial knee replacement (CPT 27446), which was denied on 2026-08-01 with the stated reason that the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the procedure. My surgeon, Dr. Lindqvist, has documented that this procedure is medically necessary, and I am asking that this decision be reconsidered.

## The plan's own criteria

The policy states that:

> "unicompartmental replacement is considered medically necessary when ALL of the following criteria have been met:"

and lists:

> "◦ function-limiting pain at short distances (e.g., walking less than one-quarter mile, limiting activity to two [2] city blocks, the equivalent to walking the length of a shopping mall) ◦ loss of knee function which interferes with the ability to carry out age-appropriate activities of daily living and/or demands of employment • Failure of provider-directed non-surgical management for at least three (3) months' duration ◦ Criteria exception:"

## How my records meet these criteria

**Imaging.** The denial states that the imaging findings do not support medical necessity. My MRI of the knee, dated 2026-06-08, shows full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial compartment with bone-on-bone apposition, and is graded Kellgren-Lawrence 4 medially. This is a documented structural finding of advanced, single-compartment disease.

**Loss of knee function interfering with activities of daily living.** My records document that I cannot climb stairs without assistance and that I wake 3-4 times nightly due to pain. My exam also shows positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain. These findings go to the policy's requirement of "loss of knee function which interferes with the ability to carry out age-appropriate activities of daily living."

*Regarding the separate short-distance-walking measure described in the same criterion, my chart as summarized to me does not separately record a specific walking distance. [If needed, I am asking my surgeon to add a note documenting any walking-distance limitation to the record.]*

**Failure of provider-directed non-surgical management for at least three months.** My records document 24 months of progressive pain, 8 weeks (2026-05-12 to 2026-07-07, 24 visits) of supervised physical therapy focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion, 8 months of NSAID use with inadequate relief, and a corticosteroid injection on 2026-05-18 that gave only 3 weeks of partial relief. This combined course of provider-directed treatment extends well beyond the three-month duration referenced in the policy, and the record shows it did not resolve my symptoms.

**Documentation requirement for non-surgical management.** The policy also states:

> "The medical record must clearly document why provider-directed non-surgical management is not appropriate."

My records document that I completed a full course of physical therapy, sustained NSAID use, and an injection, all with inadequate or only temporary relief — showing that continued non-surgical management has already been tried and has not resolved my symptoms.

## Request

Based on the plan's own published criteria and the records summarized above, I am asking Cigna to reverse this denial and approve the requested partial knee replacement (CPT 27446). I understand this appeal must be received by 2027-01-28, and I am submitting it through my.cigna.com and by mail to the appeal address printed on my denial letter, as instructed.

Please let me know if any additional records or documentation from Dr. Lindqvist would help in this review.

Thank you for your reconsideration.

Sincerely,

[Reese Mercado]
[Address]
[Phone number]
[Email address]
Member ID: W529317483

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
